method: Initial source/meaning assessment using randomized A/B labels, before opening the arm key or evidence-format fields. Not independent gold labels.

findings.observation: Need not count older employment is kind permission, although the meaning states absence of obligation.
Older-service option omits uniformity from its own meaning; a separate condition record retains a must-duty but classifies it as condition.
Grouped teacher example retains inaccurate-record condition and hours/period but omits institution categories, outside-classroom/home work and teacher-definition reference 825.102.
May be on non-FMLA leave is classified permission; possibility is a plausible source reading. Transition meaning survives.
Eligibility notice reference 825.300(b) and its topic are absent from the explicit meanings.

Generalized future-headcount example says employer has 50 or more without restating within 75 miles of the worksite. Otherwise eligible remains present, limiting certainty about practical overbreadth.

A.retained: Three eligibility requirements collectively; nonconsecutive months; >=7 versus >7 source distinctions; USERRA and written-rehire alternatives and USERRA entitlement cap; payroll week and 52-week equivalence; USERRA hours credit and generally usable schedule; leave-start timing; non-FMLA transition; headcount timing and stability; nontermination; future example.

findings.observation: Nonconsecutive months and no duty to count older service are classified permission.
Older-service permission omits uniformity from its own meaning; companion requirement retains it.

findings.type: lost governing exceptions on split meaning
findings.observation: Main FLSA calculation rule retains c(2)/aircrew exceptions; separate accurate-accounting permission omits both.
Source can generally be used becomes kind recommendation, while the meaning says may generally use rather than should.
Teacher rule retains inaccurate-record condition but compresses institution categories and omits outside-classroom/home work and teacher-definition reference 825.102.
Eligibility notice reference 825.300(b) and its topic are absent from explicit meanings.

B.retained: Cumulative three eligibility criteria; nonconsecutive months; >=7 versus >7 source distinctions; both rehire/service alternatives and USERRA cap; payroll week and 52-week equivalence; USERRA credit; leave-start timing; non-FMLA transition; headcount timing/stability; nontermination; future example.

initial_conclusion: Both retain the four formerly refused topics and the teacher condition, but neither preserves every required teacher detail/reference or resolves all classification and standalone-scope concerns. Evidence validity is not yet assessed.
